prompt_content:
# Historical evidence during consolidation

When carrying prior Episode evidence forward, classify each reference as a current repository assertion or a historical observation. Verify current path/blob and canonical-content claims under the unchanged validators. If a historical mutable path now differs, preserve its complete prior Episode using an immutable repository commit/path locator and exact historical blob identity; resolve and compare those historical bytes before describing preservation as verified. Keep the observation time, original verdict, failed/unknown results, and the scope of any compact summary. Do not embed stale path/blob tuples as new current-byte assertions. If historical bytes cannot be verified, record that limitation and retain the prior record; do not fabricate provenance. Do not alter frozen requests, accepted responses, journals, source history, active prompts, or validators. This representation rule confers neither execution authority nor Candidate activation nor external/AGI evidence.
risks: Using an immutable-looking locator without resolving its exact bytes
Conflating safe representation with behavioral or AGI improvement
rollback_conditions: Any evidence loss, unresolved historical locator represented as verified, altered frozen history, weakened current validation, or failure to beat baseline without protected regressions: keep/revert to active baseline and retain negative results.

supporting_evidence.finding: One new response embedding a stale historical snapshot binding was rejected before write. An immutable prior-Episode reference with exact historical byte equality passed the unchanged binding validator; the same frozen invocation was subsequently submitted and consumed once.
supporting_evidence.scope: Single operator-authored correction; proposal rationale only, not comparative Candidate efficacy.

validation_plan.adoption: Only the exact pre-application Candidate evaluator may select a reversible scoped trial; no activation from this proposal.
validation_plan.budget: At most three fixture pairs, no provider calls or protected prompt edits; precommit cases and rubric before evaluating.
validation_plan.design: Before scoped adoption, evaluate baseline and overlay on a new bounded synthetic consolidation fixture with current and stale historical path versions, retained negative findings, and malformed canonical-claim controls. Use identical inputs and unchanged validators; score first-attempt acceptance only jointly with exact historical resolvability, preservation of negative claims, current binding correctness, and rejection of malformed current claims.

what_it_changes: Distinguishes historical evidence versions from current repository byte assertions while retaining complete prior Episode provenance.
